items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta and full launch; counsel_required for upstream data rights and jurisdictional privacy decisions. Evidence: Woot documentation provides API access but no redistribution, historical-derivative, public-display, alert, affiliate, advertising, attribution, freshness, correction, or takedown rights; public terms restrict commercial/public product-listing use. Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only. Do not send rights outreach or change the gate until owner authorization and human-counsel review are recorded.

Fleet compliance disposition is conditional, not a fleet-wide launch clearance. Compliance baseline reports 35 pass, 20 fail, and 6 unknown, with 20 banner/accept/reject/GA4 findings and 4 privacy/terms findings. Ordinary reversible growth may continue only where existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries are preserved. Do not treat incomplete telemetry as a legal blocker by itself.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active. No SearchWoot task is closed: source-rights, alert-data-flow, GA4-consent, and logs/vendors/incident tasks lack complete evidence. Next evidence action: attach the read-only repository/configuration data-flow and retention table, then route unresolved Woot rights and jurisdictional privacy questions to human counsel before any outreach or gate change.
